notes.title: Heaven Dust 2 Update Log 20220129
notes.content:
Thank you for supporting Heaven Dust 2! 

In the latest update, we've done the following things:

[list]
[*] You can exchange Pistol Ammo for Spore from Pierce
[*] Adjust the calculation method of the damage taken by the final boss
[*] Improve the damage of the knife
[/list]

Feel free to leave a review on Steam if you like this game, and welcome to contact us if you have any problems. Thanks!

notes.title: Heaven Dust 2 Update Log 20220119
notes.content:
Thank you for supporting Heaven Dust 2! 

We've got a lot of feedback from players in the community after the released, and some bugs have been fixed so far. Welcome to contact us if you find more.

In the latest update, we've done the following things:

[list]
[*] Added 4K resolution support.
[*] Added end time settlement.
[*] Fix some known bugs.
[/list]

Feel free to leave a review on Steam after you play. Thanks!
